verification.notes: Robert Maxwell's alleged connections to Israeli intelligence/Mossad are extensively documented but remain contested. Multiple sources including books, former intelligence officials like Ari Ben-Menashe, and the PROMIS software scandal allegations support intelligence ties. Maxwell received a state funeral in Israel attended by top officials and intelligence heads. However, definitive documentary proof of formal Mossad role is absent from neutral public records, and Maxwell denied the allegations before his death.

records.text: Candace Owens cited a 2012 Los Angeles Times report that Bain Capital sought an initial $37 million fund and Robert Maxwell contributed $2 million.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Apparently, the Los Angeles Times did a piece uncovering this back in 2012. When Mitt Romney was running, they learned that he was struggling to raise the initial $37 million that they wanted for their fund. So they turned to foreign investors and Robert Maxwell gave him $2 million out of the $37 million, as well as some other foreign shady investors.

verification.notes: The cited July 19, 2012 Los Angeles Times report says Bain raised its first $37 million investment fund and that Robert Maxwell was an early investor who contributed $2 million. The citation accurately represents the article.

records.text: Jeffrey Epstein began his career in weapons trafficking and was introduced by Robert Maxwell into the Iran-Contra affair, according to testimony by a former Mossad agent.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jeffrey Epstein began his career in weapons trafficking. ... The Iran-Contra scandal, how do we know that? Because a former Mossad agent testified to that effect that he was introduced by Robert Maxwell and brought into the Iran-Contra affair.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes the claim to former Israeli intelligence figure Ari Ben-Menashe. Published interviews confirm Ben-Menashe alleged Robert Maxwell introduced Epstein while the group was involved in arms transfers to Iran, but the interview record also says Epstein did no work for the group and Ben-Menashe knew of no arms deals by him. The introduction allegation exists, but saying Epstein began his career in weapons trafficking overstates that testimony.

records.text: Mitt Romney founded Bain Capital with Robert Maxwell, whom Candace Owens described as an Israeli spy, as one of its seed investors.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, I'm going to remind you also that from the Boston Consulting Group, Mitt Romney founded Bain Capital with an Israeli spy. ... Robert Maxwell, Ghislaine Maxwell's father, as one of his seed investors.

verification.notes: Robert Maxwell was an early outside investor in Bain Capital’s first fund, but Bain partners supplied the initial capital and reliable reporting does not establish him as the singular seed investor. His intelligence ties are long alleged and disputed; describing him categorically as an Israeli spy overstates the public evidence.
